title: UniformDroppers
description: Uniformity for Dropper and Dispenser faces (Vertical)
body:
This resource pack gives uniformity to vertically and horizontally placed droppers and dispensers by setting the front face of every block (independent of orientation) to the vertical design.

As this resource pack only changes the model, this pack will work  with every other resource pack. Just make sure to put this resource pack on the top slot of the pack selection menu.

![Resoure pack in action](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3db6e54070cfee0ca58cee73529db33ac291a468.png)
